07a554cf01b12d32e989.text: A field lets go of the day's heat after dark. A city holds on to it.

09e29966057800cd6d6c.text: Twelve layers. Surface temperature, sun and shade, hours above thirty-five, the longest unbroken run.

14fff001d8747e827051.text: Change something and it solves again. Cool roofs, trees, a coating. It re-runs the physics.

19b2f590df9bca56e321.text: Take this one. Seven forty-seven Second Avenue. Thirty-four floors, nineteen seventy-two, two hundred and sixty-nine homes.

1a0e7dd4fc69d8ea7678.text: Any hour of any day. Or a month, a season, the whole year.

332d7cababc4d10cd2d9.text: Run the year and the ranking moves. Of the fifty worst in the heat wave, twelve are still worst across twelve months.

34eeb9879bd83fa825de.text: Ten height bands, one for every three storeys, and a separate answer on every face.

3c471f93cd0695de4899.text: Every cost carries a range, because tariffs and capex are assumptions.

46f004b6055626431e68.text: The north-east face, on East forty-first Street, never sees the sun. It still runs forty-one.

508f936bfc3d151ca0ba.text: So it prescribes the glass. Low solar-gain units, floors one to seven, on that one face.

605e46e57000a0e12f2f.text: This is one year over Midtown Manhattan. Eight thousand seven hundred and sixty hours. Five days over thirty-five degrees. Four nights that never dropped below twenty-six.

6206cce459084cc71601.text: And you can ask it questions.

6a2f2ded0afa57244fca.text: With a price on it, and a range, because the envelope is an assumption and the panel says so.

711703da53b221b00a1f.text: That heat is not coming from the sky. It comes off the forty-five-storey tower opposite, straight into the wall.

8ef25e07002f9f05805b.text: This one re-solved the canyon six times to answer a question about a single wall.

90ad60eedf1293ac1e9f.text: The model splits every wall three ways. Sun, the surroundings, and what it loses upward.

92535e26f8b2747ee03a.text: The north-west face takes the late sun. On the twenty-fifth floor it reaches fifty-five degrees.

9a6d875eedf0d14006ae.text: Then it spends a budget. Two million dollars, twenty buildings, thirty-three measures.

9ffd30b3238cd3368c69.text: From up there it's one number per city block, taken at head height. It's the number everyone plans with.

ac90870c98d8177a52ab.text: Down here it stops being blocks. It is walls. Twenty-nine thousand four hundred of them, on five thousand three hundred buildings.

b7a325720147ea4bd28b.text: A hundred and fifty thousand hours of exposure nobody has to sit through.

bc25b94bec9c98eecde8.text: Shading will not work here. At the peak hour the sun is twenty-six degrees up and twenty degrees off the wall. An overhang would need four metres.

caaaad43ea3aabff0a6c.text: Every wall in Midtown has an answer like that.

cc3f232948874f5fb5f3.text: Then it goes floor by floor. Surface temperature, what it costs to hold twenty-four degrees inside, hours a year it fails.

d28cfa4441803c3d0a48.text: Floor twenty-five is the worst. Fifty-five outside, forty-one to forty-eight in the rooms, and it fails for fifteen hundred hours a year.

d2d90445977c2ac94e78.text: It has the physics engine, a shell, and twenty tools. It writes the query, runs it, and shows what it ran.

f33418f8724ea770412b.text: On the flat map it's one shade of orange. It isn't one temperature.
